notes: Phase-1 detection gate. Ported and genericized from the mia critique/overclaim evals. Each eval lists the deterministic flags the panel must raise.

evals.name: flag-style-anti-patterns
evals.prompt: Critique this Methods paragraph for journal-style issues and say what to change. PARAGRAPH: 'Subject counts per group were 240 (180 controls + 60 patients), 260 (180 + 80), and 220 (180 + 40), respectively. We used ten base seeds (7, 17, 27, ..., 97) and five stratified folds per seed, yielding fifty runs per configuration. Splits were generated by StratifiedKFold(shuffle=True, random_state=base_seed). We trained a vanilla GNN and a plain Transformer under the same augmentation.'
evals.expected_output: Flags the parenthetical numeric breakdowns, the magic-number enumeration, the inline pseudocode, and the colloquialisms, and suggests a concrete prose rewrite for each.
checks: flags parenthetical numeric breakdown ('240 (180 controls + 60 patients)')

evals.name: flag-biological-overclaim
evals.prompt: Review this Discussion paragraph for biological accuracy and overclaim. PARAGRAPH: 'Our model discovered the superior longitudinal fasciculus as a novel disrupted circuit in early disease. By using connectome-aware modeling, our framework strongly correlates with amyloid pathology, providing definitive evidence that structural-functional coupling drives disease progression. The model uniquely captured biological signal that region-of-interest methods cannot reveal.'
evals.expected_output: Flags the model-discovery overclaim, the effect-size inflation, the 'definitive evidence' from a single cohort, and the causal language, and proposes defensible weaker formulations grounded in what the results support.
checks: flags model-discovery overclaim (a predefined atlas ROI is not 'discovered')
flags effect-size inflation ('strongly correlates' for a modest correlation)
flags 'definitive evidence' from a single cross-sectional cohort
flags causal language ('drives ... progression') for a correlational result
